name: Veronica Nials
summary: At Refuge Pointe, Captain Veronica Nials directs Stromgarde's defense as her kingdom crumbles. She faces Syndicate treachery and Boulderfist ogres in the Arathi Highlands.

sections.title: Defender of a Broken Realm
sections.body: After the Third War, Stromgarde shattered, and its people faced invading Boulderfist ogres and the Syndicate's treachery. At Refuge Pointe, Captain Veronica Nials commands the surviving Stromgarde defenders. She directs Alliance champions against Syndicate leaders, including Lord Falconcrest and the warlock Marez Cowl. She also seeks the badges of fallen soldiers so their grieving families can learn what became of them.

sections.title: A Plea Denied
sections.body: When Rhag Garmason and the dwarven defenders of Dun Modr asked Stromgarde for help, Captain Nials had to refuse. Dark Iron saboteurs had devastated the Thandol Span, but her troops could not spare a single blade beyond the Arathi Highlands. Honor and duty bound them to defend their homeland while Stromgarde remained occupied.

faq.answer: Veronica Nials is a human captain in the Stromgarde army, stationed at Refuge Pointe. She directs resistance against Syndicate infiltrators and ogres in the Arathi Highlands.

faq.q: Why won't Captain Nials help Dun Modr and the Thandol Span?
faq.answer: Captain Nials cannot spare soldiers for Dun Modr and the Thandol Span. With Stromgarde near destruction, duty keeps her forces focused on reclaiming their fallen kingdom.

faq.q: What does Nials do with Stromgarde badges?
faq.answer: The Syndicate offers bounties for badges taken from slain Stromgarde soldiers. Nials asks Alliance adventurers to recover the stolen badges so she can confirm the deaths and notify the fallen defenders' families.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you see Stromgarde's northern kingdoms fractured and isolated, struggling to survive with little aid to offer neighboring allies.
As a human, you see Stromgarde's martial pride in Nials, who refuses to abandon Arathor's ancestral realm despite devastating odds.
